notes: Access: direct HTTP GET (curl, desktop UA), 200s throughout, no browser needed. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic User-agent:* disallows for /cart, /profile, /auth, /wishlist, /products?q= etc.) - not a block, proceeded. Tree source: homepage nav links + /sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml (1016 URLs, grepped for bath|toilet|shower|vanity|towel|mirror|basin|faucet|tap|sanitar|commode/wc) + the site's own l1_category=lighting--decor mega-menu JSON (embedded nav data showing 'Bathroom Essentials' node, sort_order 5, sub_navigation=[Bath Mats]). Union of all three sources found only 5 bathroom-labelled collection URLs: /collection/bathroom-accessories, /collection/bath-mats, /collection/bathroom-decors, /collection/bathroom-mirrors, /collection/vanity-tables. Verified each by fetching and reading h1 + rendered '<h1> Products' count + JSON-LD ItemList of actual product titles (not just the count, since this storefront (Swadesh platform) echoes ANY unmatched /collection/<slug> as a fake page with a title-cased h1 and '0 Products' - confirmed by probing 12 made-up slugs (bathroom-furniture, bathroom-storage, bathroom-cabinets, bathroom-shelves, bathroom-organizers, wash-basin, bath-tub, shower-enclosure, towel-rack, towel-holder, soap-dispenser, toilet-seat) which all returned HTTP 200 with a plausible h1 and 0 Products despite not being real nodes - classic bad-slug-does-not-404 trap, so a bare product-count cannot be trusted without checking actual product content). Findings: (1) /collection/bathroom-accessories, 15 Products header, but JSON-LD ItemList shows every item is a textile towel (bath towel, hammam towel, beach towel, kitchen towel) - zero bathroom hardware/fixtures/accessories - TEXTILE ownership per rule 15/20, excluded. (2) /collection/bath-mats, 7 Products header, ItemList again all towels (hammam/bath/beach towel), no actual mats - TEXTILE, excluded per rule 16/20 (these are fabric items, not rubber/anti-slip bathroom mats). (3) /collection/bathroom-decors, 0 Products - empty, excluded. (4) /collection/bathroom-mirrors, 0 Products - empty, excluded (would have been BATHROOM per rule 10/11 if populated). (5) /collection/vanity-tables, 95 Products, breadcrumb/content confirms these are bedroom Dressing Tables & Mirrors (e.g. 'Baltoro Engineered Wood Dressing Table', 'Eve Engineered Wood Dressing Table with Mirror') - FURNITURE ownership (dressing table, not bathroom vanity unit), excluded per ambiguity rule 29. Checked cross_category_url_index.json for all 5 URLs - none indexed (not a dedup hit; these are boundary/classification exclusions, not already-extracted duplicates). No other bathroom-adjacent nodes exist under the site's L1 categories (bedroom-mattresses, dining-room, lighting--decor, living, sofas-recliners, storage-furniture, study) or elsewhere in the collections sitemap. Conclusion: Urban Ladder carries no genuine Bathroom fixtures/furniture/hardware/accessories category - confirmed absence, not a search-only null result (used sitemap + nav + content inspection, not site search, since /products?q= is robots-disallowed for all bots).
